task.instruction: Browse the monthly trending searches in Columbus.

final_answer:
I wasn't able to pull the actual Columbus, Ohio monthly trending list — I have to be straight with you about that rather than pass off the wrong data as yours.

What happened: I loaded Google Trends' Trending Now page with the Columbus DMA geo parameter (geo=US-OH-535) and the monthly window (date=now 1-m). The URL was correct, but the page's location selector stubbornly stayed on **Malaysia**, and every list it rendered was Malaysian data — Selangor vs Star City FC, "klinik," "pemandu," "penyampai radio," "kemiskinan," Malaysia Airlines / Amadeus breach, plus global football fixtures (Racing Santander vs Real Madrid, Barcelona vs Alavés, Lazio vs Cagliari) and the Mexico GP. I tried the location picker repeatedly — clicking the "Malaysia, select location" button, typing "Columbus" into its search box with real keystrokes, and clearing the field after it double-typed — but the suggestion dropdown never rendered, so I could never commit the switch. The geo parameter alone doesn't override the stored location preference on this page.

So the honest status: the monthly trending searches I could see (125 results, 25 per page) are Malaysia's, not Columbus's. If you want the Columbus list, the reliable path is to open the location picker manually in the browser and pick "Columbus, OH" once — after that the monthly view will populate correctly and I can read and summarize it for you. Alternatively, tell me to go ahead and report the Malaysia monthly list in full detail, and I'll do that instead.

judge.rationale: The agent did not show or report Columbus monthly trending searches; final page and answer show Malaysia/Past 24 hours data instead.
